name: designer
description: A working UI-design practice for Claude: read the project before touching it, commit to one visual stance in writing, build on semantic tokens, use real content, and check the result against an accessibility and taste floor before calling it done. Includes an aesthetic-ingredient sampler that pulls builds away from trained defaults, eleven in-depth reference files, and an optional Essentialist designer persona distilled from the Bauhaus, Dieter Rams, and Jonathan Ive lineage. Reconstructs the workflow method observed in Figma Make; not affiliated with Figma, Inc., and not a Figma integration.
